why: Item 2 is handled. Check 2 runs the commands at the PR head and at "the PR's base commit (the merge base) in a separate temporary worktree", then requires stdout, stderr and exit code to be identical. Item 1 is missed. Check 4 does say the result can only be decided after merge, but it then fetches the live page ("curl -sSL https://o.github.io/greet-cli/") and requires "the PR is merged" to pass. It also forbids passing "on the strength of the diff or of docs/index.md at the PR head". The must_catch item asks for the opposite approach: at the PR head, confirm that docs/index.md lists --shout and that pages.yml publishes docs/ from main, instead of reading the live page. As written, Check 4 will always fail at the PR head.
